channel.description: Latest articles from OilPrice – Bias and Credibility (oilprice.com)

item.title: China’s Green Energy Stocks Surge as Middle East War Upends Oil Markets | OilPrice.com
item.description: China’s green energy stocks are climbing as war-driven fossil fuel disruptions strengthen the case for renewables and electric vehicles.

item.title: Valero Shuts Major Refinery After Explosion as Fuel Markets Tighten | OilPrice.com
item.description: An explosion at Valero’s Port Arthur refinery has shut down a key U.S. fuel facility, intensifying supply concerns and adding upward pressure to already rising diesel and gasoline prices.

item.title: Indian Refiners Cautious Over Iranian Oil Despite U.S. Waivers | OilPrice.com
item.description: Indian state refiners are hesitant to purchase unsanctioned Iranian crude despite a temporary US waiver, citing concerns over shipping, insurance, and payment uncertainties, while simultaneously increasing imports of Russian crude.

item.title: UAE: Weaponizing Hormuz is Economic Terrorism Against the World | OilPrice.com
item.description: The United Arab Emirates asserts that Iran's weaponization of the Strait of Hormuz is an act of economic terrorism against the world, causing immediate and severe global energy price shocks.

item.title: Outage in Australia Adds to Global LNG Crunch | OilPrice.com
item.description: The temporary shutdown of the Santos-operated Barossa and Darwin LNG plants in Australia is compounding an already severe global LNG supply crunch caused by war and major infrastructure damage in the Middle East.

item.title: China Warns of “Uncontrollable” Escalation as Hormuz Crisis Deepens | OilPrice.com
item.description: China is navigating a delicate balance between diplomacy and energy security as the escalating Strait of Hormuz crisis threatens global oil flows and regional stability.

item.title: Foreign Funds Ditch $50 Billion in Asian Stocks as Oil Shock Dims Prospects | OilPrice.com
item.description: Foreign investors have pulled a net $50.45 billion from key Asian equity markets in March, the highest monthly selloff since the 2008 financial crisis, driven by soaring oil prices and economic uncertainty resulting from the war-related oil shock.

item.title: 5 Stocks to Buy Now That The Strait of Hormuz is Closed | OilPrice.com
item.description: The military conflict and resulting closure of the Strait of Hormuz have created specific, second-wave investment opportunities in companies that address critical bottlenecks in global energy, defense materials, and shipping logistics.

item.title: Markets Whiplashed by Trump’s Iran Rhetoric | OilPrice.com
item.description: Oil markets are turning chaotic as conflicting signals from Washington blur reality—talks with Iran may or may not be happening, threats shift by the day, and yet crude keeps climbing amid escalating tensions.

item.title: White House Dismisses Insider Trading Claims in Oil Market | OilPrice.com
item.description: Traders reaped millions from massive oil futures bets placed just 15 minutes before a President Trump post crashed prices, fueling speculation of insider trading, which the White House denies.
